description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2024: Development of a Parametrized Fragility Database for Performance-Based Structural Fire Engineering is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Emily Nakamura, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This project develops a database of fire fragility functions for steel moment frame columns using probabilistic performance-based analyses. Fragility functions estimate the probability of failure under specific fire loads, so they can be used to assess structural fire risk. This project presents a fragility database, parametrized by the demand-to-capacity ratios (DCRs) and column section sizes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (CSV, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-dq6s-8z25. Keywords: NSF NHERI SimCenter, Fragility Function, Monte Carlo Simulation, Uncertainty Propagation, Risk Assessment, Fire. Published 2024-11-22. Facility named: SimCenter. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
